title: Machine Learning & NLP Specialist
description:
We are seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to design and deploy NLP and transformer-based models in production. You will build inference APIs in FastAPI and scale containerized deployments.

Qualifications:
- 3+ years experience in Python, PyTorch/TensorFlow, and Scikit-learn.
- Proven track record deploying ML models via Docker and FastAPI.
- Experience with NLP, embeddings, and vector similarity search.
education_requirements: Master's or Bachelor's in Computer Science, Data Science, or Mathematics
